name: StepFun
short: StepFun's open platform API for the Step model family (multimodal reasoning, vision, speech, image), with pay-as-you-go per-token pricing and tiered rate limits.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: step-5-preview $1.00 in / $2.70 out per 1M ($0.10 cached in). Rate limits scale with cumulative top-up.

plans.name: Step Plan
plans.notes: Monthly credit allowance governed by the subscribed tier; separate from pay-as-you-go top-up tiers.
